recent.title: LOCAL SYSTEM ENVIRONMENT FOR CLOUD BASED DEVELOPMENT
OPTIMIZING CONTAINER STARTUP PERFORMANCE USING BLOCK LAYER STORAGE

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "anyscale", 2026-09-22

profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. According to its website, it is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy foundation models and AI at scale on any cloud. The company describes its offering as orchestrating model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability.

The site presents Anyscale as production-scale AI infrastructure. It carries a testimonial from Anastasis Germanidis, who says Anyscale allows his team to scale workloads seamlessly and removes risk around infrastructure, and another from an unnamed applied AI engineer who says a model went from a suggestion to running in production the next day, a process that previously would have taken a week or more.

The company's record here lists no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
